info.name: Clio API Documentation Activities Reminders API
Return the data for all Reminders

params.name: created_since
params.description: Filter Reminder records to those having the `created_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).

params.name: fields
params.description: The fields to be returned. See response samples for what fields are available. For more information see the [fields section](#section/Fields).

params.name: ids[]
params.description: Filter Reminder records to those having the specified unique identifiers.

params.name: limit
params.description: A limit on the number of Reminder records to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 200. Default: `200`.

params.name: notification_method_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single NotificationMethod. The keyword `null` is not valid for this field. The list will be filtered to include only the Reminder records with the matching property.

params.name: order
params.description: Orders the Reminder records by the given field. Default: `id(asc)`.

params.name: page_token
params.description: A token specifying which page to return.

params.name: state
params.description: Filter Reminder records to those with a given state.

params.name: subject_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single CalendarEntry or Task. The keyword `null` is not valid for this field. The list will be filtered to include only the Reminder records with the matching property.

params.name: subject_type
params.description: Filter Reminder records to those of a given subject type, required if using subject_id.

params.name: updated_since
params.description: Filter Reminder records to those having the `updated_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).

params.name: user_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single User. The keyword `null` is not valid for this field. The list will be filtered to include only the Reminder records with the matching property.
